description: Structure-based simulation of dynamic PET quenching and FRET for dyes tethered to proteins by flexible linkers: accessible volume, Brownian dynamics and photon Monte-Carlo on IMP.bff.

project.description: The QuEst project document (see doc/parameters.md). Every length is in Angstrom, every time in nanoseconds.

rpc_methods.name: quest.template
rpc_methods.summary: Return a minimal valid project, optionally with FRET.

with_fret.description: Add an acceptor dye and a Forster matrix.

rpc_methods.name: quest.validate
rpc_methods.summary: Check a project and report why it is malformed.

pdb_path.description: Structure override; a path or a bare four-character RCSB PDB ID.

rpc_methods.name: quest.simulate
rpc_methods.summary: Run one simulation and return the decay and derived metrics.

tac_range.description: Time window of the histogram in nanoseconds, [start, stop].

project_dir.description: Base directory for the jobs/<uuid> output folder.

save_outputs.description: Write the job directory. Opt-in: without it a run leaves nothing behind. When set and no project_dir is given, artefacts go to the per-user artefact root, never the working directory.

result_schema.description: Decay arrays, quantum yields, lifetime, AV/contact volumes, FRET channel and the per-residue-type quenching breakdown.

rpc_methods.name: quest.scan
rpc_methods.summary: Simulate a set of labeling sites and return one record each.

positions.description: fps.json-shaped positions, keyed by site name.

results.description: Per site: lifetime, quantum yield, contact fraction, volumes and the dominant quencher. A site that fails is reported with status='failed' rather than aborting the scan.

rpc_methods.name: quest.parameter_catalog
rpc_methods.summary: Return the parameter catalog (labels, units, help), optionally translated.

locale.title: Language
locale.description: Locale code (en, de, fr). Omitted means English — a shared backend must not answer in whatever language its host machine is configured for.

rpc_methods.name: quest.dyes.list
rpc_methods.summary: Return the dye presets.

rpc_methods.name: quest.dyes.save
rpc_methods.summary: Add or replace a dye preset.

dye.description: Dye entry; its 'name' is the key it is stored under.

rpc_methods.name: quest.quenching_defaults
rpc_methods.summary: Return the residue-type PET chemistry defaults.

rpc_methods.name: quest.structure.metadata
rpc_methods.summary: Return the chains, residues and atoms of a structure file.

pdb_path.description: Structure path, or a bare four-character RCSB PDB ID.

chains.description: Per chain: its residues in sequence order, each with sorted atom names.

pdb_text.description: Raw file contents, for a viewer.

rpc_methods.name: quest.runs.list
rpc_methods.summary: Return run-artefact summaries, newest first.

limit.description: Page size; clamped to the server maximum.

rpc_methods.name: quest.runs.get
rpc_methods.summary: Return a finished run's result.

rpc_methods.name: quest.locales
rpc_methods.summary: List the languages QuEst's labels and help text are available in.

locale.title: Language
locale.description: Locale code (en, de, fr). Omitted means English — a shared backend must not answer in whatever language its host machine is configured for.

rpc_methods.name: quest.contract.describe
rpc_methods.summary: Return the contract: methods, schemas, error codes and where serialization happens.

rpc_methods.name: quest.jobs.list
rpc_methods.summary: Return the running and recent operations.

rpc_methods.name: quest.jobs.get
rpc_methods.summary: Return one operation's status and progress.

rpc_methods.name: quest.jobs.cancel
rpc_methods.summary: Ask a running operation to stop at its next checkpoint.

rpc_methods.name: quest.analysis.template
rpc_methods.summary: Return the declared analysis stages, fit presets and fit settings.
rpc_methods.description: Everything quest.analysis.run accepts, read from settings/analysis/{stages,fit_parameters}.yaml: the stages in run order with their titles and graphs, the presets as differences to the full settings, every declared fit setting, the shipped data folder and the declared result tables.

rpc_methods.name: quest.analysis.run
rpc_methods.summary: Run stages of the quenching analysis (inverse fit), blocking or as a background job.
rpc_methods.description: The Bayesian graph fit of measured site lifetimes against the site model (stages A, B, naive_h2o, C, summary). Always a job: listed by quest.jobs.list, with progress and a cooperative cancel (quest.jobs.cancel) that stops at the next search, joint-fit evaluation or profile point. The declared tables, summary.json and report.md are written to the output folder or the run directory.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: "all" (the declared order A, B, naive_h2o, C, summary), one stage name, or a list. A stage also runs what it needs (C solves the joint graph).

data.title: Measurements
data.description: Folder with the three measurement CSV files (site lifetimes, titration points, titration summary). Omitted: the shipped MalE data (examples/male).

structures.title: Structures
structures.description: {state: structure path} the site tables are built on. Omitted: the shipped MalE structures (APO 1OMP, HOLO 1ANF).

tables.title: Stored site tables
tables.description: {"STATE:site:linker_length": npz path}: use stored site tables (for example the MalE prototype cache) instead of building them.

cache_dir.title: Site-table cache
cache_dir.description: Folder the built site tables are cached in. Omitted: <settings>/cache/quenching_estimator/site_tables.

preset.title: Fit preset
preset.description: "full" (64 searches, the published run) or "quick" (8 short searches; a test run, less reliable). Omitted: the declared settings (as full).

fit_overrides.title: Fit settings
fit_overrides.description: Declared fit settings to replace after the preset, e.g. {"n_starts": 4}. quest.analysis.template lists them.

workers.title: Workers
workers.description: Worker processes for the searches (1 = in process; the numbers do not depend on it). Omitted: the CPU count.

profile.title: Profile likelihood
profile.description: Compute the declared quench-scale profile likelihoods (about one joint fit of the block per point).

output.title: Output folder
output.description: Write the declared tables (<stage>.<table>.csv), summary.json, report.md and run.json here. Omitted: the run directory <runs>/<job_id>.

project_dir.description: Base directory of the jobs/<uuid> run directories (default: the per-user artefact root).

save_outputs.title: Save
save_outputs.description: Write the results to disk (the output folder or the run directory). False keeps them only in the reply and in this server's memory.

background.title: Background
background.description: Return the job_id at once instead of waiting; poll quest.jobs.get, stop with quest.jobs.cancel, fetch with quest.analysis.result.

continue_from.title: Continue from job
continue_from.description: job_id of a finished analysis job on this server whose solved graphs are reused (stage C after stage A costs nothing). Its inputs and fit settings win.

result.description: Per stage (title, numbers, text, tables as row lists in the declared result_columns.yaml columns, plots) and per graph (blocks, size). A stored run read from disk has no plots.

rpc_methods.name: quest.analysis.result
rpc_methods.summary: Return the result of an analysis job or of a stored analysis run.
rpc_methods.description: A job this server ran (by job_id) returns the full result with plot data; a stored run (by its directory name under jobs/) returns its summary.json and run record. A job still running fails with job_not_finished, a cancelled one with operation_cancelled.

job_id.title: Job
job_id.description: The analysis job's id (also its run directory name).

project_dir.description: Base directory of the run directories (default: the per-user artefact root).

result.description: Per stage (title, numbers, text, tables as row lists in the declared result_columns.yaml columns, plots) and per graph (blocks, size). A stored run read from disk has no plots.

rpc_methods.name: quest.analysis.site_table
rpc_methods.summary: Build or read one site table and return its summary.
rpc_methods.description: The per-voxel features of one labelled site (neighbour counts per residue group, quencher contacts, water exposure) that the site model evaluates, from the cache or built on IMP.bff. Building one takes seconds to a minute.

state.title: State
state.description: Structure state (APO or HOLO for the shipped MalE structures).

dye.title: Dye
dye.description: Take the declared linker length of this dye (AF488, Cy3B, Atto655).

linker_length.title: Linker length
linker_length.description: Stretched linker length in Angstrom; overrides the dye's.

structure.title: Structure
structure.description: Structure file; the shipped MalE structure of the state by default.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: Labelled chain; the declared chain by default.
